references.text: Describes the Levitical cities and pasturelands that were to be given to them among the children of Israel, which forms the basis for their inheritance right mentioned in Leviticus 25:33.
The fulfillment of the promise regarding the Levitical cities, where 48 cities were given to the Levites from the inheritance of the other tribes.
The introduction of the Jubilee year, when property was to be returned, which is the context for the Levites' right of redemption.
The preceding verse explaining that the Levites have a permanent right of redemption for their houses in the Levitical cities.
Explains that the Levites were not to have any inheritance among the children of Israel, but that the Lord was their inheritance, making the Levitical cities their only earthly possession.
Reiterates that the tribe of Levi shall have no inheritance share with Israel, but that the Lord is their inheritance.
Ezekiel's vision of a holy area for the priests and Levites in the future land, which relates to the special inheritance right of the Levites.
